card.name: edge36 hub · spoke-0 · spoke-1
card.role: one cluster manages the other two

def.what: Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management, ACM, runs on a hub cluster and manages other clusters, called managed clusters or spokes.
def.creator: Clusters are registered to the hub once, at setup.
def.reader: Every controller in this video runs on either the hub or a spoke.
def.where: Hub: edge36. spoke-0: edge95. spoke-1: edge97.
def.analogy: Head office and two branch offices.

card.name: hammerdb-rhel9
card.role: the database VM we are protecting

def.what: OpenShift Virtualization runs full virtual machines as Kubernetes objects. A VirtualMachine is the definition. A VirtualMachineInstance, VMI, is the running copy inside a pod.
def.creator: Applied from Git by GitOps (Argo CD, introduced below).
def.reader: KubeVirt starts a virt-launcher pod that runs the guest.
def.where: Namespace gitops-vms on whichever spoke runs the app.
def.analogy: The VirtualMachine is the recipe, the VMI is the dish on the table.

card.name: hammerdb-rhel9-rootdisk
card.role: creates and fills a VM disk

def.what: A DataVolume asks the Containerized Data Importer, CDI, to create a PersistentVolumeClaim and fill it, for example by cloning an OS image or leaving it blank.
def.creator: Applied from Git by GitOps (introduced below): rootdisk and datadisk.
def.reader: CDI creates PVCs with the same names, and the VM mounts them.
def.analogy: An order form that says: give me a 35 gig disk, preloaded with RHEL.

card.name: 23dfdc6d-3feb-4281-83bb-69287b7b1a35
card.role: the data-disk session: VSA-B copies changed blocks to VSA-A

def.what: Each spoke stores its disks on its own Dell PowerStore virtual array. A replication session on the array copies a volume's changed blocks to the peer array on a schedule.
def.creator: The PowerStore CSI driver, when replication is enabled.
def.reader: The peer array keeps a read-only destination copy.
def.where: spoke-0 uses VSA-A, spoke-1 uses VSA-B, over NVMe over TCP.
def.analogy: A courier that drives a fresh copy of your files to the other office every few minutes.

def.what: A cluster-scoped class that tells the storage driver which replication settings to use, here a 15 minute schedule.
def.creator: Created once on each spoke during setup.
def.reader: csi-addons passes its parameters to the PowerStore driver.

card.name: hammerdb-rhel9-datadisk
card.role: turns replication on for one PVC

def.what: Asks for one PVC's volume to be replicated, and in which role: primary means writable source, secondary means read-only destination.
def.creator: The VolumeReplicationGroup (next) creates one per protected PVC.
def.reader: The csi-addons controller translates it into gRPC calls on the PowerStore CSI driver.
def.where: Same namespace as the PVC, on the spoke.
def.analogy: A work order for the courier: this disk, this timetable, you are the sender.

card.name: dell-vm-drpc
card.role: protects all the app's disks on one spoke

def.what: Ramen's per-spoke object for one application. It finds the app's PVCs by label, creates their VolumeReplications, and saves their definitions to S3. Its state is Primary or Secondary.
def.creator: The hub delivers it to both spokes.
def.reader: Ramen's spoke controller acts on it, and the hub reads its status back.
def.analogy: A site manager at each office who knows which boxes belong to this customer.

card.name: ramen-metadata
card.role: remembers which disk belongs to which claim

def.what: An S3 bucket, served by MinIO on the hub, where Ramen stores copies of the protected PV and PVC definitions.
def.creator: The Primary VRG uploads them.
def.reader: A VRG that becomes Primary on the other spoke downloads them.
def.where: MinIO on the hub, bucket ramen-metadata.
def.analogy: The labels for the boxes, kept in a safe at head office.

card.name: dr-policy-15m
card.role: pairs the two spokes, 15 minute schedule

def.what: A cluster-scoped hub object that names the two peer clusters and the replication interval.
def.creator: Created once on the hub during setup.
def.reader: Each DRPlacementControl points at one DRPolicy.
def.analogy: The contract between the two branch offices.

card.name: dell-vm-placement
card.role: the question: which cluster runs this app?

def.what: An ACM object that asks which clusters an application should run on.
def.creator: Applied from Git into openshift-gitops on the hub.
def.reader: Normally the ACM scheduler answers it. Here an annotation switches that off, so only Ramen answers.
def.analogy: A job posting: we need one office to run this.

card.name: dell-vm-placement-decision-1
card.role: the answer: the chosen cluster list

def.what: The answer to a Placement: a list of selected cluster names.
def.creator: Here, written only by Ramen's hub operator.
def.reader: The ApplicationSet generator polls it to decide where to deploy.
def.where: Hub, openshift-gitops, labeled with the Placement name.
def.analogy: The posted result: office spoke-1 gets the job.

card.name: dell-vm-drpc
card.role: the DR control panel for one app

def.what: Ramen's hub object for one protected application. It points at a Placement and a DRPolicy, selects PVCs by label, and accepts actions like Failover.
def.creator: Applied from Git. The console edits its action field.
def.reader: Ramen's hub operator reconciles it and reports phase and conditions.
def.where: Hub, openshift-gitops, next to its Placement.
def.analogy: The control panel with the big red failover switch.

card.name: dell-vm-drpc-gitops-vms-vrg-mw
card.role: a parcel the hub ships to a spoke

def.what: An ACM object on the hub that wraps Kubernetes manifests. The work agent on the named spoke applies them there.
def.creator: Ramen (for VRGs) and the GitOps propagation controller (for Applications).
def.reader: The work agent on the spoke.
def.where: Hub, in the spoke's cluster namespace.
def.analogy: A sealed parcel addressed to one branch office.

card.name: dell-vm-drpc-gitops-vms-vrg-mcv
card.role: a window to read spoke status

def.what: An ACM object on the hub that asks a spoke for the current copy of one of its objects.
def.creator: Ramen's hub operator.
def.reader: Ramen reads the returned VRG status to decide its next step.
def.where: Hub, in the spoke's cluster namespace.
def.analogy: A status report the branch office faxes back.

card.name: dell-vm-workload
card.role: stamps out one Application per chosen cluster

def.what: An Argo CD object that generates Applications from a template. Our generator reads the PlacementDecision.
def.creator: Applied from Git into openshift-gitops on the hub.
def.reader: The ApplicationSet controller polls the decision every 180 seconds.
def.analogy: A mail-merge: one letter per name on the list.

card.name: dell-vm-workload-spoke-0
card.role: deploy this Git folder to that cluster

def.what: An Argo CD object: sync this Git path to this cluster and namespace, and keep it that way.
def.creator: Generated by the ApplicationSet, one per selected cluster.
def.reader: Argo CD on the spoke syncs it (pull model).
def.where: Hub copy in openshift-gitops, delivered to the spoke's openshift-gitops.
def.analogy: One mail-merged letter: office spoke-0, build exactly what is in this folder.

define.text: The hub only generates the Application. The spoke's own Argo CD does the sync.
